inputs.input_ids: [1, S] int32 (bos=2 ... eos=1, right-padded with pad=0; image slots hold 258880)
inputs.mm_embeds: [1, S, 512] float16 soft tokens at their slots (zeros elsewhere), unscaled
inputs.mm_mask: [1, S] float16 (1 at a soft-token slot)

output.embedding: [1, 768] float16, L2-normalized; Matryoshka: keep the first 512/256/128 and re-normalize

text_only_use: mm_embeds = 0 and mm_mask = 0 give the text embedding (bit-identical to the v1.0 main_<S> functions)

inputs.patches: [1, 2520, 768] float16: 16x16x3 patches (py, px, c), integer pixel values 0..255 (not /255), CELL-MAJOR order, zero padded
inputs.cos: [1, 1, 2520, 64] float16 axial RoPE cos (channels 0-31 by x, 32-63 by y, 16 freqs theta 100 duplicated)

vision.resize: aspect-preserving to multiples of 48 px within 2520 patches; antialiased bicubic on uint8 (torchvision-exact)
vision.exif_orientation: not applied (upstream parity); optional in the runners

image_sequence: <bos> <|image> <|image|> x n_soft <image|> <eos>  (n_soft + 4 tokens, at most 284 -> bucket 288)

inputs.features: [1, Tb, 128] float16 log-mel frames (10 ms hop, 128 HTK mel bands, ln(mel + 1e-3)), the first n_frames rows real, zero after
inputs.frame_mask: [1, Tb] float16 (1 for the first n_frames rows)
inputs.half_mask: [1, Tb/2] float16 (1 for the first ceil(n_frames/2) rows)
inputs.token_mask: [1, Tb/4] float16 (1 for the first ceil(ceil(n_frames/2)/2) rows = the soft-token count)

output.soft_tokens: [1, Tb/4, 512] float16; rows >= n_tokens are padding

audio.resampler: Kaiser-windowed sinc, pass band 0.913 / stop band 1.0 of the lower Nyquist, 125 dB (upstream: libsoxr HQ)
audio.long_audio: the first 30 s (upstream); the runners also offer the mean of 30 s windows

audio_sequence: <bos> <|audio> <|audio|> x n_tokens <audio|> <eos>  (n_tokens + 4 tokens, at most 754 -> bucket 1024)
tokenizer: tokenizer/tokenizer.json (unchanged Gemma tokenizer; the runner adds <bos> and <eos>)
